visualizations.title: Actual vs Predicted Yield by Crop Type
visualizations.description: Scatter plot showing actual vs predicted yields with crop types colored differently. Includes perfect prediction line and error band.

insights: Model shows consistent underprediction bias (mean residual +50.16)
Highest errors observed in Nutri/Coarse Cereals, Small Millets, and Shree Anna/Nutri Cereals
data.summary: Created visualization showing prediction errors across 21 crop types. Identified three high-error categories with systematic underprediction patterns.
data.task_answer: The highest yield prediction errors occur in Nutri/Coarse Cereals, Small Millets, and Shree Anna/Nutri Cereals. These crops likely have unique growth patterns or limited training data causing prediction challenges. The model systematically underpredicts yields by ~50 units on average.
